MISPRINTS: none found, and one suspected class was checked and cleared. p02 carries a genuine digit-for-Roman misprint at Q22(c) and Q24(c) ("Both 1 and II"). The corresponding options in my band -- Q29(c) and Q43(c) -- were cropped at 8x and both print a serifed Roman I identical to the I in their own "I only" option, so both read "Both I and II" correctly and neither warrants a flag.

PRINTED WORDING WORTH KNOWING: Q28 asks "then what is A VALUE OF sin(theta) + cos(2theta) ?" -- "a value of", not "equal to". Transcribed verbatim rather than normalised to the paper's usual phrasing. Q35 prints its lower bound as a bare "0" with no degree sign while its upper bound carries one ("30 degrees"); transcribed exactly as printed.

UNREADABLE: nothing. Every stem, every option and every exponent in this band was confirmed against a 6-8x crop of the source PDF.

questions.stem:
Which of the following equations is/are possible ?

I. \(\sin^2\theta = \frac{(x+y)^2}{4xy}\), where x, y are positive unequal real quantities.

II. \(\sin\theta + \cos\theta = x + \frac{1}{x}\), where x is a positive real quantity.

Select the correct answer using the code given below :
questions.subtopic: Maximum and Minimum of Trigonometric Expressions

questions.stem: If \(m^2(\sin\theta - 1) + n^2(\sin\theta + 1) = 0\), where \(0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}\), then what is \((m^2 + n^2)\cos\theta - (m^2 - n^2)\cot\theta\) equal to ?
If \(\sin\alpha + \cos\alpha = \sqrt{2}\), where \(0 < \alpha < \frac{\pi}{2}\), then what is \(\sin^3\alpha - \cos^3\alpha\) equal to ?

If \(\tan\theta = \frac{\sin\alpha - \cos\alpha}{\sin\alpha + \cos\alpha}\), where \(\theta\) and \(\alpha\) \(\left(\alpha \ne \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\) are acute angles, then what is \(\sqrt{2}\sin\theta\) equal to ?
For how many values of \(\alpha\) does the expression \((\sin\alpha + 2)(\sin\alpha + 4)(\sin\alpha - 2)(\sin\alpha - 4)\) become zero ?
questions.subtopic: Maximum and Minimum of Trigonometric Expressions

questions.stem: What is the value of x, where \(0 \le x < 30^\circ\), satisfying \(\tan 3x \tan 6x = 1\) ?
What is \(\frac{(a-b)^2}{(b-c)(c-a)} + \frac{(b-c)^2}{(c-a)(a-b)} + \frac{(c-a)^2}{(a-b)(b-c)} - 3\) equal to, where \(a \ne b \ne c\) ?
Given that \(\frac{100 \times 99 \times 98 \times \ldots \times 3 \times 2 \times 1}{100^n}\) is an integer. What is the largest value of n for which this is true ?

A man starting from a place P went x metre \((x > 120\text{ m})\) East before turning South. He went 40 m straight before turning to West. He went 60 m to reach a place Q. From Q he went 200 m North and reached a place R. If PR = 200 m, then what is x equal to ?
If \(x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = 3\), where x, y and z are integers, then how many values can \((xy + yz + zx)\) have ?
If x, y, z are real numbers such that \(x + y + z = 10\) and \(xy + yz + zx = 18\), then what is the value of \(x^3 + y^3 + z^3 - 3xyz\) ?
What is the maximum value of the sum of the numbers 36, 33, 30, 27, 24, ... ?

I. The remainder when \((m + n)\) is divided by 12 is 10.

II. The remainder when \((m - n)\) is divided by 12 is 10.
